Purchasing says they cannot reorder the HL Mountain Pedal (product number PD-M562) from any supplier. Why?

Customer 12145 says that in May 2025 they received an order confirmation email for an order they never placed. Why?

Finance flagged online order 73806, from a customer in the United Kingdom: the local-currency amount derived for it is wildly out of line with similar orders placed the same day. What is wrong with the order?
Starting in February 2025, the Southwest territory's reseller sales dropped sharply while Canada's jumped, even though Southwest resellers kept ordering at their usual pace. Explain.
Gross margin for the Helmets product subcategory turned sharply negative from May 2025, although helmet prices and sales volumes did not change. What happened?
Accounts payable suspects that Norstan Bike Hut billed us twice for a single June 2025 delivery. Is that right? Investigate.
Online revenue from mountain tires in June 2025 is about half of what unit sales would suggest at list price. Why?
